visualFindings.finding: Source-blue toning is removed. Actual head-above-torso and left/right near-arm pixel differences are zero; outside-torso pixels, including lower limbs, are unchanged. The 58 projected protected-graph overlap pixels are not by themselves proof of changed arm/head art; source ROI checks are separate.
Complete fine bladder face protection uses a 1.5 source-pixel guard. Opaque and antialias foreground differences are both zero; the previous six boundary pixel changes are gone.

Full orange bladder face/outlet is clean in final actual images. No inner blood U-loop or groove is visible. Its supply port remains a deep continuation under the preserved orange face, not a real exposed lumen opening.

Light-blue original bronchial branches remain foreground and the blood access arcs do not visibly weld to airway tips. The lung exchange loops are split by this foreground and can still look like isolated purple segments.

Actual full-body/torso/lower images hide the internal stomach S return, liver loop, lung capillary arcs and heart overlays beneath intact original organ faces. The fine source-derived bowel/pancreas convex-hull hiding envelope closes distracting small gap windows without replacing any original tissue/food pixel. Small post-mask exposed components without a nearby named port are rendered at 10 percent opacity; continuous blood approaches remain. This is an intentional overview display envelope, not a changed organ boundary or gameplay obstacle.

Actual cutaway-torso has softer hidden ends than the prior short fade. e164 and e188 inward alpha samples visibly ramp, but the stomach blue S/intestinal partial lines remain recognizable as diagram-like overlays on original organ pigment. This is not a complete natural wall-section battlefield.
visualFindings.minimumNextArtAdjustment: Judge the wall-section presentation with actual existing .15 fill and real cell glyphs before widening or adding texture. Keep original food/air/bladder foreground, frozen routes and named ports; no graph redesign in this art pass.

visualFindings.finding: The intact overview only reveals existing external approaches. Internal graph tracing belongs to the registered cutaway layer and is not visible on the complete organ face.
The producer now splits material centerline runs by fixed source foreground support before applying fades. Final alpha is still inspected separately.

limits: This independent pass reviews the final files with hiddenEndFade, not initial-fragments-rejected.png.

The earlier black-luminance overview mask did not subtract in CairoSVG. This audited revision checks every per-component clipPath against the independently reconstructed Shapely difference, not merely its metadata.
Pixel and geometry checks do not replace native rendering/performance or RTS navigation tests.
Source preserved pixels include AI-painted broad blood lines; preserving them does not certify each original pigment junction as graph topology.
